fields.title: Number of clusters
fields.description: Number of clusters to use for the algorithm.

fields.title: Maximum number of iterations
fields.description: This is the maximum number of iterations to be performed.

fields.title: Fuzzifier
fields.description: Indicates how much the clusters are allowed to overlap.

fields.title: Use seed for random initialization
fields.description: If this checkbox is set, a seed can be set for initializing the cluster prototypes.

fields.title: Random seed
fields.description:
The seed value used for random number generation. Use the same seed to get identical clustering results
across multiple executions.

fields.title: Draw seed
fields.description: Generate a random seed and set it in the Random seed input above for reproducible runs.

fields.title: Always include all columns
fields.description: If checked, node behaves as if all columns were moved to the Include list.

fields.title: Used attributes
fields.description:
Select the columns that are to be used for clustering. Make sure that the input data is
normalized to obtain better clustering results.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Induce noise cluster
fields.description: Whether to induce a noise cluster or not.

fields.title: Delta computation method
fields.description: Choose whether to set a fixed delta value or to compute it automatically based on lambda.

fields.title: Perform the clustering in memory
fields.description: If this option is selected, the clustering is performed in the memory, which speeds up the process.

fields.title: Compute cluster quality measures
fields.description:
Whether to calculate quality measures for the clustering. This can be time and memory consuming with large
datasets.
